alt: 騎馬教練領著學員沿林間步道前進，學員專注看著領頭的馬並跟隨轉彎。
scene_prompt: Modern children's horseback riding club: a calm experienced riding instructor leads a small group of riders along a safe marked forest trail; all riders look toward and follow the leader's horse turning at a fork. Emphasize attentive following, not battle. Correct horse anatomy and tack, riders seated safely, no extra limbs.
